Title: Risk Manager III, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Amazon is building a new payment method, and we need a risk leader to shape it from the ground up. As a Risk Manager III within our Payments organization, you will own the strategy and portfolio lifecycle management for a high-growth consumer financial product. You will design data-driven underwriting policies, run champion/challenger experiments, and translate portfolio analytics into action before deterioration reaches the P&L. Working closely with partners in finance, technology, and product teams, you will balance profitable volume growth with loss containment and customer experience. If you are a self-starter who thrives on building new capabilities in ambiguous environments, this is your opportunity to define how financial risk is managed at Amazon. Key job responsibilities Design and maintain the end-to-end origination policy, including score cutoffs, decision trees, income verification rules, initial line assignment, and segment-level pricing, then lead periodic calibration of each component. Own the portfolio lifecycle strategy by defining proactive and reactive line adjustments, transactional authorization rules, and preventive treatments for early-stage delinquent accounts before they enter collections. Build and execute the champion/challenger testing program for origination, including test cell design, sample sizing, maturation windows, swap-in/swap-out analysis, and reject inference that feeds the modeling team. Monitor the full origination funnel and portfolio health through vintage analysis, roll rates, transition matrices, and 12-to-24-month loss and balance forecasts, reconciling monthly against actuals and escalating early warning signals to financial and risk committees. Partner with legal, regulatory, finance, and technology teams to interpret applicable laws and business policies, represent financial risk programs to senior leaders and external auditors, and align risk reduction strategies with the broader organizational framework. A day in the life You will start your morning reviewing portfolio performance dashboards, checking approval rates, First and Second Payment Default trends, and vintage loss trajectories against established thresholds. From there, you will join working sessions with the modeling team to assess experiment results and calibrate line assignment strategies, then coordinate with commercial and operations partners to align origination targets with risk appetite. You will prepare committee-ready narratives, reconcile the monthly risk P&L against forecast, and apply your judgment to trade-offs between short-term volume goals and long-term portfolio health. About The Team We are the first team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our financial risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English 7+year experience in consumer credit risk management and origination policy for consumer lending products. Experience managing complex, cross-functional risk programs, influencing roadmaps and business and technology decisions across one or more organizations. Experience designing and executing testing programs. Experience producing loss and balance forecasts (12–24 months),portfolio KPIs and risk-adjusted P&L by segment. Title: LAC A&H Business Planning & Analysis Manager
Description: American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. Building on more than 100 years of experience, today AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance, life insurance, retirement solutions, and other financial services to customers in more than 80 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets, manage risks and provide for retirement security. At AIG, we protect our clients against uncertainty and risk and provide the confidence for tomorrow’s opportunities. Join us as LAC A&H Business Planning & Analysis Manager to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team. Make your mark in Underwriting AIG Underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, and Multinational Clients. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG. Reporting to the Head of Accident & Health, Latin America & Caribbean (LAC), this role serves as a key business partner to regional and local leadership teams, providing financial, operational, and strategic insight to support profitable growth across the A&H portfolio. The LAC A&H Business Planning & Analysis Manager is responsible for leading business planning, forecasting, performance management, portfolio analysis, and executive reporting activities for the LAC A&H business. In collaboration with country, regional, and global stakeholders, the position will help drive business decisions through actionable analytics, financial insights, and monitoring frameworks that support both tactical execution and long-term strategic objectives. How You Will Create An Impact Drive Business Performance and Financial Results Partner with regional and country A&H leadership to monitor, analyze, and improve business performance against production, profitability, growth, and expense targets. Deliver financial and operational insights that enable management to understand portfolio performance, identify opportunities, and address emerging risks. Analyze key performance indicators, business trends, portfolio drivers, and variances against Budget, Forecast, Strategic Plan, and Prior Year. Support leadership in evaluating business performance across products, countries, distribution channels, and customer segments. Develop and maintain management reporting frameworks that facilitate effective performance monitoring and decision-making. Lead Planning, Forecasting, and Business Management Activities Coordinate and support annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning activities for the LAC A&H business. Work closely with Finance, Product, Distribution, Actuarial, and Country Management teams to align business assumptions and financial expectations. Monitor progress against financial commitments and identify risks and opportunities to achieve annual objectives. Contribute to the development of actionable business plans that support profitable growth and portfolio optimization. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual business review processes for regional and global stakeholders. Provide Strategic Analytics and Decision Support Deliver ad hoc analyses and business insights to support tactical and strategic decision-making. Evaluate business opportunities, portfolio initiatives, distribution partnerships, and growth strategies through financial and operational analysis. Develop scenarios, business cases, and performance assessments to support management discussions and investment decisions. Identify key drivers of growth, profitability, retention, and expense performance and provide recommendations for corrective actions or improvement opportunities. Support portfolio management initiatives by assessing business mix, channel performance, customer concentration, and profitability trends. Enhance Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Performance Frameworks Develop, improve, and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting frameworks used across the A&H organization. Promote consistent use of key performance indicators and management information across countries and functions. Leverage analytics and data visualization techniques to provide timely, actionable business insights. Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes, data quality, and business monitoring capabilities. Partner with Finance and Operations teams to improve efficiency, automation, and transparency of management reporting. Support Executive Communication and Stakeholder Management Lead the preparation of business reviews, operating updates, strategic presentations, and other executive-level communications. Present analysis, recommendations, and business insights to regional and senior leadership audiences. Establish strong relationships across regional, country, and global functions to support collaboration and alignment on key initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating financial and operational information into actionable recommendations. Support leadership in communicating performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities to internal and external stakeholders. What You'll Need To Succeed Technical Skills & Experience Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Preferred minimum of 5+ years of experience in business analysis, financial planning, FP&A, strategic planning, consulting, or related analytical roles. Experience in budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and financial reporting. Strong quantitative, analytical, and financial modeling capabilities. Experience developing executive presentations and communicating complex business issues to senior management. Insurance industry experience is strongly preferred, particularly within Accident & Health, Life, or Property & Casualty businesses. Experience working in multinational and matrix organizations is preferred. Knowledge of business intelligence and reporting tools is a plus. Previous experience or familiarity with Accident & Health reinsurance business development and market management activities within the Andean Region or Central America markets is highly desirable and would be a plus. Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Proficiency in Spanish and English is required. Portuguese knowledge is desirable. Leadership Skills Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple organizational levels. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams. Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Strong business acumen and ability to connect financial results with operational drivers. Self-starter with the ability to work independently and proactively. Results-oriented mindset focused on delivering actionable insights and business value. Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and innovation. Strong executive presence and presentation skills. Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you. At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike. Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family. Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become. Welcome to a culture of inclusion We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations. AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories. AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities.
